## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run lint:knip` and `npm run typecheck` are green
- [ ] `npm run test:coverage` is green and coverage thresholds hold
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` is green (including axe checks)
- [ ] `npm run build` and `npm run budgets` are green
- [ ] No personal data in the repository (event files, fixtures, screenshots)
- [ ] UI copy added in both catalogues (de-CH and en), Swiss spelling in de-CH
- [ ] Accessibility checked: keyboard operation, visible focus, contrast, screen-reader text
- [ ] Docs, CHANGELOG and ADRs updated where a decision or behaviour changed
